name: folder-search-windows
title: Folder Search for Windows
description: Find, pin and open folders instantly on Windows, including Google Drive and external drives.
author: alan_zirpoli

commands.name: search-folders
commands.title: Search Folders
commands.description: Find folders by name, then open, reveal, browse or pin them.

commands.name: index-folders
commands.title: Rebuild Folder Index
commands.description: Rescan your drives so Search Folders finds new folders.

preferences.name: searchRoots
preferences.title: Search Roots
preferences.description: Folders to search in, separated by ; (e.g. G:\Il mio Drive;D:\Progetti). Leave empty to search your user folder and every other drive (external disks, Google Drive…).

preferences.name: sort
preferences.title: Sort Results By
preferences.description: Order of the results returned by Everything (when installed).

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Max Results
preferences.description: Maximum number of folders to show.

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Terminal used by the “Open in Terminal” action.

preferences.name: editorCommand
preferences.title: Editor Command
preferences.description: Command used by “Open in Editor” (e.g. code, cursor, zed).

preferences.name: esPath
preferences.title: es.exe Path
preferences.description: Optional. Full path to es.exe, the Everything command-line tool. Leave empty to detect it automatically.

preferences.name: indexDepth
preferences.title: Index Depth
preferences.description: How many folder levels deep the built-in index goes (used for Google Drive, external disks and anything Everything doesn't index).

preferences.name: indexMaxAge
preferences.title: Index Refresh (hours)
preferences.description: Re-index a location when its index is older than this.
